positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.locationName: San Diego, California, United States · Hybrid

positions.title: Associate Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Develops software requirements, related design, and code.
•	Performs software testing.
•	Applies and maintains quality standards.
•	Assesses severity of problems, determines corrective action and implements solutions.  
•	Revises and updates programs and documentation.
•	Assists in specification preparation and the assessment of products.
•	Assists in the writing of reports, manuals and procedures.
•	Keeps abreast of improvements in programming techniques.

positions.title: Tutor
positions.description:
•	Individually assisted 200+ students with programming assignments, in-class quizzes/exams.
•	Graded students’ assignments/exams accurately according to the professor’s standards.
•	Attended weekly meetings with professor to debrief students’ progress and discuss how to improve the class.
•	Effectively communicated with students by enforcing concepts to facilitate good programming practices.
